source.title: Race Cards
ocrNotes: Transcribed from seven supplied race-card images.

Printed spelling, capitalization, abbreviations, and apparent typographical errors are retained in rawOcrText and sourceText. Structured names use display capitalization; ability-code normalization is noted where applicable.
